The Big Idea

You were born with a toolkit. The question is: how are you using it?

Think of your natural abilities as a toolkit you were born with. Some tools may come naturally to you. Some may be strengths you've always relied on. Some may be gifts you've never fully recognised. And some may be tools you haven't learned how to use yet.

But having the tools isn't enough. You have to understand them. Use them. Develop them. And keep them sharpened.

Meet Your Coach

Helping you understand what you were born with — and what you can do with it.

Sunny Nagpal is an NLP International Trainer, certified Trainer of Trainers from the American Board of NLP, two-time TEDx speaker and Brain Coach. For years, Sunny has worked with individuals and organisations to explore how people are naturally wired — and how greater self-understanding can support more intentional choices, performance and personal development.

ThriveCode360 is the evolution of that work, created as a structured environment for women to understand themselves more deeply and design their next chapter.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before you join.

ThriveCode360 is designed for women aged 30–50 who want a deeper understanding of how they are naturally wired and want to use that understanding to recognise their strengths, decode patterns, clarify their values and purpose, and design a more intentional next chapter.

It's a membership experience that combines coaching, assessments, weekly missions, worksheets, recordings, community access and personal feedback.

You'll work toward a clearer understanding of your natural wiring, strengths, gifts, patterns, values and direction — plus practical tools, frameworks and a 90-day action plan to help translate insight into action.

Your working map of how your brain is naturally wired to thrive — bringing together your natural wiring, tendencies, gifts and strengths into a framework you can refer back to.

ThriveCode360 is structured as an ongoing membership experience rather than a short one-time course. Your membership provides lifetime access to the program resources and experience.

Weekly missions, live coaching calls, assessments, worksheets and frameworks, session recordings, private community access, personal feedback and practical tools.

The Silver Lifetime Membership is ₹9,999 as a one-time payment.

Complete the enrollment form with your name, mobile number and email address, then continue to secure payment.

No. ThriveCode360 is a personal development and brain coaching program. It is not therapy, psychological diagnosis or medical treatment, and should not replace professional medical or mental-health care.

ThriveCode360 places self-understanding at the centre of the journey. Rather than simply giving you more information to consume, it helps you understand your natural wiring, recognise your strengths, identify recurring patterns, and translate those insights into intentional action.
